title: Six Claude Code Releases, One Theme: Silent Failure
caption:
I don't mind when my agent fails. I mind when it doesn't tell me.

Six Claude Code releases landed between August 17 and 21. Read them together and the pattern is hard to miss: messages reported as sent that were dropped, denies that didn't stick, a session sitting idle while it was still working, and a proxy bug that quietly doubled billed API calls on Bedrock.

I spent a week blaming myself for at least two of these.

Which one got you?

slides.headline:
Six releases.
One theme:
silent failure.
slides.sub: Claude Code 2.1.234 through 2.1.239 shipped between August 17 and 21. Read together, most of what got fixed had been failing without telling you.

slides.title: Billed twice, silently
slides.sub: A proxy stripping Content-Type made Bedrock re-run every turn non-streaming, doubling billed API calls. Fixed in 2.1.239, August 21.

slides.title: Sent. Never delivered.
items: A session set to refuse inbound messages returned silent success (2.1.238)
An inbox dropping messages on rate limit told the sender nothing (2.1.238)
SendMessage reported a burst as sent while the inbox dropped it (2.1.236)

slides.title: State it never reported
items: Session-scoped denies dropped when answering background subagent prompts (2.1.234)
Esc on a queued prompt left the session looking idle mid-turn (2.1.239)
ListAgents treated a too-long session list as no sessions at all (2.1.234)

slides.title: Your voice drifted back
slides.sub: Custom, project and plugin output styles reverted to the default voice mid-session. Fixed in 2.1.238, August 20.

slides.title: Memory it never freed
items: Subagent tool results held for the whole session, not just the display window (2.1.238)
WebFetch kept expired pages in memory past the intended 15 minutes (2.1.239)

slides.headline:
Which one
bit you?
